anr-baidu-1.webp.zh: 从空中俯瞰安特卫普机场：草地环绕的跑道与滑行道之间散布着机库，右侧是公路与仓储区。
anr-baidu-1.webp.en: Antwerp from the air — hangars scattered between the grass-ringed runway and taxiways, with roads and warehouses to the right.

anr-baidu-2.webp.zh: 航站楼与塔台：低矮的白色航站楼横贯画面，中央矗立着黑色的控制塔台。
anr-baidu-2.webp.en: The low white terminal with its dark control tower rising at the centre of the apron.

anr-baidu-3.webp.zh: 从航站楼屋顶眺望机坪：塔台与登机设施尽收眼底，地勤车辆停在机位旁。
anr-baidu-3.webp.en: Looking across the apron from the terminal roof — the tower, boarding stands and ground vehicles in view.
